design.revision: four centered monitors, About Me no table, music no plant/window + pendant

architecture.furniturePreservation: Furniture geometry unchanged; upper props translated +0.07 with adjusted floor, pendant follows ceiling +0.08.

architecturalFill.scope: Soft global rear fill for architectural review

guitarSoundhole.construction: Full circular opening through soundboard and body shell; opaque recessed backplate closes acoustic cavity

pickguard.shape: Narrow at upper soundhole edge, concave inside rim, rounded broad lower lobe

living.pillowSeam: Equatorial seam at cushion edge, no inset rectangular front panel
living.armNormals: Welded continuous bevel normals on curved arm profile
living.fringeAttachment: Follows exact analytic folded hem point
living.pillowShape: Closed polar-surface plush cushion with softly bowed uneven outline, tapered corners and swollen face
living.portraitStyle: Procedurally illustrated warm chestnut chin-length bob, subtle eyes and smile, sage blouse

cafe.geometryStrategy: Frontal compound espresso chassis; closed lathe cups and rounded stools; tube handles/hooks; flattened notes without folds; layered board and six-pane window
cafe.coffeeBowlProfile: Rounded wide profile rather than straight cone
cafe.cupProfile: Rounded porcelain foot, softly flared nearly straight wall, thick rim, hollow inner bowl and D handle
cafe.windowStrategy: Real beveled hollow frame, inset blue pane backing, 2x3 open glazing cells, slim mullions

monitor.upholsteryStrategy: Closed convex superellipsoid continuous bulge, no shell steps
monitor.donutStrategy: Thin beveled annular sectors, not tubes

sculpture.geometry: Closed ring loft continuous torso/neck, integrated facial displacement, pupil-free inset sculpture eyes, attached carved scalp shell and tapered elliptical locks; cloth grooves integrated into torso surface

anatomy.type: rigid generic classical decorative bust; not a named likeness or animated humanoid

sculpture.performanceNote: Inherited approved house exceeds original 350000 target; preserve accepted unrelated room meshes and report actual triangle count, do not silently claim target met.

externalAsset.scope: New source room props; original chest shape restored; natural wood and house satin palette
externalAsset.sourceMethod: User-provided Tripo geometry, no local smoothing or sculpting; approximate performance simplification and material adaptation

externalAsset.geometryPolicy: Keep thin R4 positions and outline unchanged; uniform pure white with no grain or cardboard edge effects. Correct planar face normals and triangle winding to remove dark edge artifacts.

paperboard.silhouettePolicy: Keep every approved x/y vertex; no gap contraction or contour smoothing.
paperboard.finish: Plain white; no fiber grain, tinted edge, surface maps or sheen.

materials.name: cream satin

albedo.samplingNotes: Flat painted surface, base color inferred apart from warm highlights.

textureProjection.texelDensityIntent: Preserve stable world/object-scale detail; do not stretch micro detail with component scale.

roughness.localResponse: higher roughness in cavities, lower roughness on worn edges

ambientOcclusion.notes: Darken creases, seams, intersections, and recessed local features.

shaderNotes: Prefer MeshPhysicalMaterial when clearcoat, sheen, transmission, or thin-surface response is observed; otherwise use MeshStandardMaterial-compatible PBR channels.
Generate albedo, roughness, height/normal, and AO independently; never alias albedo into roughness.
Use normal/bump/displacement only when they map to observed surface relief.
Use displacement geometry when the observed relief changes the close-up silhouette; texture-only relief is insufficient there.
materials.notes: Smooth collectible miniature; no heavy clay grain or dark outline.

referencePbr.method: single-image pixel evidence with de-lighting estimate; not photogrammetry
referencePbr.hardLimit: A single image cannot uniquely recover true albedo/roughness/normal/AO; maps are reference-derived estimates.
warnings: foreground mask is tiny; material extraction is likely unreliable
image is not clearly isolated from background; using most pixels as material evidence
object/background separation is weak
low value range weakens height/roughness inference

previewColorCalibration.reason: compensates studio tone mapping and observed brightness; reference palette unchanged
